This '''torture droid''' used by [[Ban Papeega]] to torture [[Thurlow Harris]] to extract the name of the [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|pilot]] who destroyed the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. It was destroyed when Vader flew into a rage and killed all the bounty hunters, except for [[Mala Mala]].
